design_direction.rendering: Large connected flat pixel color clusters; no continuous black or substitute dark perimeter line; silhouettes separate using local colors and broad shadow planes
design_direction.palette: Original honey gold, caramel, chestnut and ivory
design_direction.expression: Subtle natural closed-mouth smile; relaxed friendly amber eyes
design_direction.silhouette: Fox ears, short side ponytail, one golden tail with cream tip, gold shoulder cape, ivory sleeves, brown vest and opaque leggings
design_direction.starting_weapon: One broad rigidly straight two-handed steel greatsword
design_direction.scene: Aspirational riverside town concept using existing project motifs; not a runtime screenshot
design_direction.production_note: Reference sheets are not animation atlases. Coarse pixel targets in prompts are art direction, not measured native sprite dimensions.

prompts.character_design:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW PORTRAIT character design sheet for this game's fox-girl protagonist, painted in the exact BIG COLOR BLOCK, OUTLINELESS PIXEL style of INPUT IMAGE 1.
IMAGE 1 (the user-provided pale-gray pixel character sheet) is the DOMINANT reference for rendering technique, pixel coarseness, simplification, flat shapes and sheet layout.
IMAGE 2 (existing golden fox girl) is ONLY a reference for her identity and ORIGINAL WARM COLORS. Ignore image 2's illustration rendering and outlines completely.
The user's essential instruction: "我希望你学习的是这个像素画的大色块，无明显黑色描边的绘画风格". Respect this literally.

RENDERING ABOVE ALL: NO black outline. NO dark perimeter line. NO brown or plum substitute contour line. NO traced ink borders around hair, face, arms, coat, tail, sword or legs. Each silhouette meets the background directly in its LOCAL FILL COLOR. Separate adjacent forms by broad flat local-color and shadow shapes, not by drawing a line between them. Render like a small actual hand-pixeled game character at approximately 80–96 native pixels tall, then enlarged into very large square blocks. Sparse almost abstract face, each eye a tiny dark amber dash of 1–2 logical pixels, mouth a small cheerful coral mark. Connected broad graphic clusters; head hair is only THREE large flat gold shapes, not individually drawn strands. Clothes only TWO shades per cloth. One broad shadow plane per limb. NO tiny highlight flecks, stipple, scattered single-pixel noise, shading texture, high resolution anime face, eyelashes or detailed boot lacing. Hard square edges, visible long stair-step silhouettes, NO smoothing/antialiasing, NO gradients. Warm reduced palette of about 12–16 colors total. Match the degree of abbreviation of image 1.

SAME PROTAGONIST: youthful female fox traveler, slim roughly 4.8-head-tall proportions, honey-yellow GOLD hair with a short playful side ponytail, 2 triangular warm-brown-tipped FOX EARS with cream inner area (not horns), ONE large golden/caramel fox tail with cream tip. Keep gold, caramel, chestnut brown and ivory as the original dominant palette. Cheerful bright open expression, amber eyes, tiny open smile, ears perked, lightly tilted head and energetic relaxed stance. Modest fully clothed travel outfit: a very simple GOLD short shoulder cape, IVORY high-neck long-sleeve tunic, CHESTNUT sleeveless vest, plain brown belt, brown shorts over completely opaque chocolate leggings, chunky practical brown boots with gold cuffs. Simplify all garment details into broad quiet shapes; no decorative dangling thin cords or fine trim.
ONE plain broad straight steel greatsword with a brass guard and long brown grip. In main view, both mitten-simplified hands hold the SAME upright grip beside her, stacked vertically; pommel, grip, guard center and blade tip exactly in one vertical line. Sword broad light steel shape and one muted gray shadow plane, no ink edge; fully inside the canvas.
SHEET: pale warm light-gray solid background. Large full-body front three-quarter view on LEFT, smaller full-body rear view upper RIGHT, happy head close-up lower RIGHT; small flat warm palette swatches near an outer edge, like input 1. Same garment construction and ivory sleeves in every view. Rear view clearly shows gold cape and one cream-tipped gold tail. Rear hands relaxed, no extra sword. Close-up remains deliberately coarse and sparse, do NOT turn it into detailed anime illustration. All figures spaced cleanly, all ears, feet, tail and blade fully visible.
A restrained warm gentle nostalgic pixel look. No navy/black coat, no platinum hair, no detailed anime drawing, no contour lines, no pixel filter over an illustration, no 3D, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark.
prompts.smile_revision:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the mouth expression in this exact outlineless large-color-block pixel character reference sheet.
The user approves this image's style and design and says: "这个不错，表情不需要那么大，微笑".
In BOTH the large front full-body figure and the lower-right head portrait, replace the wide open coral mouth with a TINY NATURAL CLOSED-MOUTH SMILE: a small subtle 2–3-logical-pixel warm rose/coral smile mark. Lips closed, no teeth, no open mouth, no tongue. Relaxed friendly expression, soft happy eyes, quietly cheerful. Keep the same eyes and eyebrows as closely as possible; only adjust a pixel if essential for a gentle smiling expression. Do not make the face sad or sleepy. Rear view has no visible face and remains entirely unchanged.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE exactly: sheet composition, all figure poses, proportions, coarse pixel grid, big connected flat color blocks, golden-honey hair and side ponytail, warm brown fox-ear tips, single golden tail and cream tip, gold cape, ivory sleeves and tunic, brown vest and opaque leggings, boots, sword shape and placement, both stacked hands, palette swatches, light-gray backdrop. Maintain NO dark outline and NO brown/plum contour line; silhouette colors meet background directly, local broad shadow planes only. Do NOT add fine detail, change the outfit, smooth edges, add linework, extra pixels of texture, text or watermark. Keep a conspicuously low-resolution pixel look.
prompts.scene_reference:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one widescreen 16:9 IN-GAME SCENE ART REFERENCE for the Godot game yu.
IMAGE 1 is the FINAL CHARACTER DESIGN and DOMINANT STYLE reference. Match its OUTLINELESS very coarse BIG FLAT COLOR BLOCK pixel art exactly, plus the exact warm golden fox girl and her subtle closed-mouth smile.
IMAGE 2 is the user's original PIXEL STYLE reference; it reinforces large quiet connected color masses and absence of obvious black contour lines.
This is concept art of the project's riverside town, not an actual screenshot.

IMPORTANT PAINTING METHOD: shapes are filled COLOR BLOCKS with no outlines. NO black, brown or plum line around character, hair, face, boots, sword or buildings. Local fill colors meet the neighboring shapes directly. Separate overlapping forms using a broad value change or ONE flat shadow region. Very coarse hand-pixel graphic style, around 288 x 162 logical pixels for the whole scene, enlarged with large hard square blocks and conspicuous stair steps. Main character approximately 60–70 logical pixels tall. 2 shades per material, 3 at most. NO drawn strands, tiny texture, stipple, individual roof tiles, detailed masonry, little flowers with many petals or detailed foliage. Hair and tail are a few uninterrupted gold and cream masses; clothes are large ivory, gold and brown panels. Eyes only tiny amber marks, mouth only a SMALL CLOSED-MOUTH SMILE. Do not render a detailed illustration and then pixelate it.

The SAME youthful feminine fox traveler as image 1: honey-gold hair and short side ponytail, two warm-brown-tipped fox ears with cream inside, ONE rich gold tail with cream tip, golden ochre short shoulder cape, ivory high-neck blouse with IVORY long sleeves, brown sleeveless vest, ivory tunic panels, brown shorts over opaque chocolate leggings, brown boots with gold cuffs. Preserve this original GOLD / CARAMEL / CHESTNUT / CREAM palette, relaxed friendly face, perked ears and gentle smile. Slim roughly 4.8-head-tall proportions, not chibi.
She pauses on the riverside path near lower center-left, full-body height about 38 percent of image. Both hands hold the SAME straight upright long grip of ONE broad steel greatsword beside her, blade tip near the ground. Pommel, grip, crossguard midpoint and blade tip form one straight vertical axis. Sword plain light steel fill with one gray shadow plane and gold horizontal guard; no border. Both arms clear; one tail and two legs.

Surroundings based on the current project's RiversideTown: a broad pale stone path in front, quiet blue-sage river on the right, a short low stone bridge across midground, an ivory plaster-and-timber shop with a muted blue roof on the left, another shop with a soft terracotta-red roof further right; a simple lamp, wooden railing, a few blocky elm tree canopies and small garden color patches. Distant pale hills and small houses. SIMPLE EDITED SHAPES with lots of uncluttered flat space. Preserve ample walkable room to the right. Almost eye-level 2.5D gameplay camera with shallow downward tilt, upper third pale sky and large simple cream cloud blocks. Depth comes from overlapping broad planes and quiet distant colors, not detail or camera blur.
Fresh gentle daylight, warm cream light, muted sage and blue-gray surroundings; protagonist stays golden and readable without an outline. A welcoming, lighthearted adventure mood. No all-over yellow filter or dark gothic atmosphere.
No HUD, writing, signage, title, collage, model-sheet panels, border, watermarks, painterly gradients, soft edges, antialiasing, bloom, 3D render, anime ink linework or black outlines.
